subject: Fastest air freight to ORD
body:
Hi,

Could you quote an all-in price in EUR for the fastest air freight option to ORD (Chicago, US)? Please arrange trucking from our site in 51447 Bergisch Gladbach, Germany, to the departure airport. The shipment is ready for pickup on 2026-11-25.

It’s 12 pieces of printed marketing material, 676 kg gross and 5.79 cbm.

Sara
Lindqvist Medtech
